title: Refined Jukebox Jr.
body: The Refined Jukebox Jr. holds 4 different music discs, being able to also skip a disc to others and so on, making it easier to make multiple music and better logic of it. 0 power - pauses disc, 1 power - skip record, 5 power - play record, and 10 power - eject the record. It can only be interacted with automatically with interactor, but only ejecting the record. Manual is a better option.
